# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Neuroscience ][169]

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Pharmacist in a white coat holding a prescription bottle in a pharmacy, with shelves of medications
and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## Noch Fragen?

[Frau mit Kaffebecher in der Hand nutzt dermanostic am Handy.]
* ### Wie läuft die Behandlung ab?
  
  Zunächst beantwortest Du einen medizinischen Fragebogen und lädst Fotos der betroffenen Hautstelle
  hoch. Nach Zahlung wird Dein Anliegen an eine unserer Dermatolog:innen übermittelt.
  
  Diese Analysieren Deine Angaben und senden Dir im Anschluss Diagnose & Therapieempfehlung über
  unsere App zu. 
* ### Muss ich mit einem Arzt sprechen?
  
  Nein, unsere Ärzte führen die Diagnose anhand Deiner Angaben und Bilder in unserem medizinischen
  Fragebogen durch. 
* ### Welche Kosten fallen an?
  
  Die Kosten richten sich nach Deinem ausgewählten Servicepaket.
  
  Basis 29€
  
  Plus  39€
  
  Express 69€
  
  Bitte beachte, dass es sich um eine Selbstzahlerleistung handelt und Du die Kosten für das
  Medikament selbst tragen musst.
* ### Was für Ärzte behandeln mich?
  
  Alle Ärzte, die Dich bei dermanostic behandeln, sind in Deutschland zugelassene [Fachärzte für
  Dermatologie][53] und haben somit eine umfangreiche Erfahrung in diesem Gebiet.
  
  Wir gewährleisten durch unseren zusätzlichen **medizinischen Expertenkreis** und **wöchentlichen
  Fallkonferenzen** eine hohe Qualität der gestellten Diagnosen.
* ### Ist eine Krankschreibung möglich?
  
  Aktuell stellen wir keine Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung aus. Bitte wende Dich dafür an Deinen
  Hausarzt.
* ### Übernimmt meine Krankenkasse die Kosten?
  
  Alle Leistungen werden nach der **Gebührenordnung für Ärzte** (GOÄ) erstellt. Grundsätzlich
  handelt es sich deshalb um eine Selbstzahler-Leistung.
  
  Aktuell übernehmen die folgenden gesetzliche Krankenkassen die Kosten: [VIACTIV][54] Krankenkasse,
  die [BKK Linde][55] Betriebskrankenkasse, die [BKK Akzo Nobel][56], die [BIG direkt gesund][57],
  die [Postbeamtenkrankenkasse][58] (PBeaKK), sowie die [BKK BBraun][59].
  
  Außerdem kannst Du unseren Service über den Teledoktor der BARMER nutzen.
  
  Weitere gesetzliche Krankenkassen folgen in Kürze.
  
  In der Regel erstatten private Krankenkassen dermanostic im Basis-Paket vollständig, d.h. sowohl
  die Kosten für unsere Behandlung als auch für die Medikamente. Im Plus und Express-Paket kann
  unter Umständen nur eine teilweise Erstattung durch die privaten Versicherer erfolgen.

## Noch Fragen?

[Frau mit Kaffebecher in der Hand nutzt dermanostic am Handy.]
* ### Wie läuft die Behandlung ab?
  
  Zunächst beantwortest Du einen medizinischen Fragebogen und lädst Fotos der betroffenen Hautstelle
  hoch. Nach Zahlung wird Dein Anliegen an eine unserer Dermatolog:innen übermittelt.
  
  Diese Analysieren Deine Angaben und senden Dir im Anschluss Diagnose & Therapieempfehlung über
  unsere App zu. 
* ### Muss ich mit einem Arzt sprechen?
  
  Nein, unsere Ärzte führen die Diagnose anhand Deiner Angaben und Bilder in unserem medizinischen
  Fragebogen durch. 
* ### Welche Kosten fallen an?
  
  Die Kosten richten sich nach Deinem ausgewählten Servicepaket.
  
  Basis 29€
  
  Plus  39€
  
  Express 69€
  
  Bitte beachte, dass es sich um eine Selbstzahlerleistung handelt und Du die Kosten für das
  Medikament selbst tragen musst.
* ### Was für Ärzte behandeln mich?
  
  Alle Ärzte, die Dich bei dermanostic behandeln, sind in Deutschland zugelassene [Fachärzte für
  Dermatologie][53] und haben somit eine umfangreiche Erfahrung in diesem Gebiet.
  
  Wir gewährleisten durch unseren zusätzlichen **medizinischen Expertenkreis** und **wöchentlichen
  Fallkonferenzen** eine hohe Qualität der gestellten Diagnosen.
* ### Ist eine Krankschreibung möglich?
  
  Aktuell stellen wir keine Arbeitsunfähigkeitsbescheinigung aus. Bitte wende Dich dafür an Deinen
  Hausarzt.
* ### Übernimmt meine Krankenkasse die Kosten?
  
  Alle Leistungen werden nach der **Gebührenordnung für Ärzte** (GOÄ) erstellt. Grundsätzlich
  handelt es sich deshalb um eine Selbstzahler-Leistung.
  
  Aktuell übernehmen die folgenden gesetzliche Krankenkassen die Kosten: [VIACTIV][54] Krankenkasse,
  die [BKK Linde][55] Betriebskrankenkasse, die [BKK Akzo Nobel][56], die [BIG direkt gesund][57],
  die [Postbeamtenkrankenkasse][58] (PBeaKK), sowie die [BKK BBraun][59].
  
  Außerdem kannst Du unseren Service über den Teledoktor der BARMER nutzen.
  
  Weitere gesetzliche Krankenkassen folgen in Kürze.
  
  In der Regel erstatten private Krankenkassen dermanostic im Basis-Paket vollständig, d.h. sowohl
  die Kosten für unsere Behandlung als auch für die Medikamente. Im Plus und Express-Paket kann
  unter Umständen nur eine teilweise Erstattung durch die privaten Versicherer erfolgen.

As broadcasters migrate to HD and seek to deliver an enhanced user experience, they are also under
constant pressure to offer more services per multiplex as a means for reducing transmission costs.
Dibsys, comprehensive DVB-T2 distribution solution can help Digital Terrestrial Television (DTT)
operators overcome these challenges by combining high compression efficiency with the ability to
deliver outstanding video and audio regardless of the format and standard.
* High Performance
* Flexibility and Stability
* High Adaptability and Availability
* Lower CAPEX/OPEX

With fast development of the digital video broadcasting technology, Mobile Terrestrial Digital
Audio/Video and Data Broadcasting Service is necessary for improving Customer Premise' watching
experience.
One Seg technology in ISDB-T/Tb system (Japan, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Uruguay, Peru and the
Philippines) is typical application in recent years.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

## Lybrate: India's Best Patient Consulting Portal

Are you struggling to find a trusted doctor for optimal medical care? Look no further; search on
Lybrate! As India's premier patient consulting portal, Lybrate provides access to a database of over
150,000 doctors with expertise in diagnosing and treating conditions across various medical
specialties. With Lybrate, doctor consultations become effortless through a seamless appointment
scheduling process, granting you quick access to highly experienced doctors in just a few clicks. At
Lybrate, we are building the future of healthcare delivery by providing expert medical care on the
go.

## Lybrate Presence in India

Lybrate currently boasts a network of 150+ clinics, 800+ partner hospitals, a panel of 400+ super
specialist surgeons, and a database of over 1,50,000 doctors. Our presence spans 7 metro cities in
India - Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata - as well as in several
Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Nagpur, Bhopal,
Ludhiana, Patna, Bhubaneswar, Coimbatore, Ahmedabad, Agra, Gwalior, Kochi, Vizag, Surat, Noida,
Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Jammu, and Guwahati.

We are continuously expanding our reach to serve people across the nation and beyond, providing them
with holistic and seamless medical care. For expert medical care on the go, choose Lybrate.

## Connect with Best Doctors in India for Various Categories

At Lybrate, we are committed to delivering comprehensive patient care spanning various medical
specialties.

**Proctology:** Specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the rectum and anus,
including but not limited to hemorrhoids, anal fissures, and colorectal conditions.

**Laparoscopy:** Involves the treatment of various abdominal and pelvic conditions using minimally
invasive surgical procedures. These surgeries employ small incisions and a camera for diagnosis and
treatment, resulting in a shorter recovery period.

**Vascular:** Focuses on conditions affecting blood vessels, arteries, and veins, with deep vein
thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and varicose veins being the most common conditions.

**Urology:** This specialty involves the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the urinary
tract and male reproductive system, including kidney stones, bladder and prostate issues, etc.

**Gynecology:** This medical specialty deals with conditions of the female reproductive system such
as ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, and infertility. Pregnancy care is also an integral part of
gynecology.

**ENT:** Disorders of the ear, nose, and throat fall under this medical specialty. Common conditions
addressed by ENT specialists include throat infections, sinusitis, hearing loss, congestion, and
vertigo.

**Aesthetics:** Cosmetic procedures aimed at enhancing a person's physical appearance are part of
aesthetics. Some procedures include liposuction, tummy tuck, breast Lift surgery, breast
augmentation surgery, and rhinoplasty.

**Dermatology:** Dermatology is a branch of medicine that deals in the diagnosis and treatment of
conditions of the skin and hair. Some dermatological treatments include Botox, Derma Fillers, Face
Thread Lift, and Hair Transplant.

**Orthopedics:** Specialists in this field diagnose and treat musculoskeletal conditions affecting
bones and muscles, such as joint pain, arthritis, and fractures.

**Ophthalmology:** This specialty involves the management of treatments affecting eye health,
ranging from refractive errors to more serious conditions such as cataracts and glaucoma.

**Fertility:** This specialty focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the
reproductive system. In vitro fertilization and intrauterine insemination are some common fertility
treatments offered under this specialty.

**Weight Loss:** Weight loss involves safe and effective methods for achieving a healthy body
weight. Bariatric Surgery and Intragastric Balloon treatment are examples of weight loss procedures.

**Dentistry:** Dentistry encompasses diagnosis and treatment of diseases and conditions affecting
the teeth and gums. Common treatments include braces, aligners, and dental implants.

## Lybrate: India's Best Patient Consulting Portal

Are you struggling to find a trusted doctor for optimal medical care? Look no further; search on
Lybrate! As India's premier patient consulting portal, Lybrate provides access to a database of over
150,000 doctors with expertise in diagnosing and treating conditions across various medical
specialties. With Lybrate, doctor consultations become effortless through a seamless appointment
scheduling process, granting you quick access to highly experienced doctors in just a few clicks. At
Lybrate, we are building the future of healthcare delivery by providing expert medical care on the
go.

## Lybrate Presence in India

Lybrate currently boasts a network of 150+ clinics, 800+ partner hospitals, a panel of 400+ super
specialist surgeons, and a database of over 1,50,000 doctors. Our presence spans 7 metro cities in
India - Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Kolkata - as well as in several
Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Indore, Nagpur, Bhopal,
Ludhiana, Patna, Bhubaneswar, Coimbatore, Ahmedabad, Agra, Gwalior, Kochi, Vizag, Surat, Noida,
Gurgaon, Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Jammu, and Guwahati.

We are continuously expanding our reach to serve people across the nation and beyond, providing them
with holistic and seamless medical care. For expert medical care on the go, choose Lybrate.

## Connect with Best Doctors in India for Various Categories

At Lybrate, we are committed to delivering comprehensive patient care spanning various medical
specialties.

**Proctology:** Specializes in the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the rectum and anus,
including but not limited to hemorrhoids, anal fissures, and colorectal conditions.

**Laparoscopy:** Involves the treatment of various abdominal and pelvic conditions using minimally
invasive surgical procedures. These surgeries employ small incisions and a camera for diagnosis and
treatment, resulting in a shorter recovery period.

**Vascular:** Focuses on conditions affecting blood vessels, arteries, and veins, with deep vein
thrombosis, peripheral artery disease, and varicose veins being the most common conditions.

**Urology:** This specialty involves the diagnosis and treatment of conditions affecting the urinary
tract and male reproductive system, including kidney stones, bladder and prostate issues, etc.

**Gynecology:** This medical specialty deals with conditions of the female reproductive system such
as ovarian cysts, uterine fibroids, and infertility. Pregnancy care is also an integral part of
gynecology.

**ENT:** Disorders of the ear, nose, and throat fall under this medical specialty. Common conditions
addressed by ENT specialists include throat infections, sinusitis, hearing loss, congestion, and
vertigo.

**Aesthetics:** Cosmetic procedures aimed at enhancing a person's physical appearance are part of
aesthetics. Some procedures include liposuction, tummy tuck, breast Lift surgery, breast
augmentation surgery, and rhinoplasty.

**Dermatology:** Dermatology is a branch of medicine that deals in the diagnosis and treatment of
conditions of the skin and hair. Some dermatological treatments include Botox, Derma Fillers, Face
Thread Lift, and Hair Transplant.

**Orthopedics:** Specialists in this field diagnose and treat musculoskeletal conditions affecting
bones and muscles, such as joint pain, arthritis, and fractures.

**Ophthalmology:** This specialty involves the management of treatments affecting eye health,
ranging from refractive errors to more serious conditions such as cataracts and glaucoma.

**Fertility:** This specialty focuses on the diagnosis and treatment of conditions of the
reproductive system. In vitro fertilization and intrauterine insemination are some common fertility
treatments offered under this specialty.

**Weight Loss:** Weight loss involves safe and effective methods for achieving a healthy body
weight. Bariatric Surgery and Intragastric Balloon treatment are examples of weight loss procedures.

**Dentistry:** Dentistry encompasses diagnosis and treatment of diseases and conditions affecting
the teeth and gums. Common treatments include braces, aligners, and dental implants.

# Psoriatic Disease Resources for Every Step of Your Journey

# Psoriatic Disease Resources for Every Step of Your Journey

From the basics of psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis to treatments, insurance hurdles, and managing
day to day life, the Patient Navigation Center has a resource for you.

[Go to the Resource Library][4]
[Products][5][Stories][6][Donate][7]

### The mission of the National Psoriasis Foundation is to drive efforts to cure psoriatic
### disease and improve the lives of those affected.

Over 8 million people in the U.S. have psoriasis. Nearly a third of them will develop psoriatic
arthritis. A world without psoriatic disease and the related burdens is possible. We won't stop
until you have the cure you deserve. 

## Your experience with psoriatic disease is unique.

Which best describes you?

Select One:
* [I am not sure if I have psoriasis.][8]
* [I am newly diagnosed.][9]
* [I am living with psoriasis.][10]
* [I am living with psoriatic arthritis.][11]
* [My treatment isn’t working.][12]
* [I am supporting someone.][13]
* [I am a health care provider.][14]
* [I am interested in research.][15]

## What's New at NPF

[Psoriasis Uncovered]

## Psoriasis Uncovered

The Psoriasis Uncovered podcast delves into the complexities of psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, and
related conditions.

Listen to the latest episode

## 4 Psoriasis Shampoos Your Scalp Will Love

Looking for a medicated hair product that keeps the itching and flaking at bay? Discover which
shampoos have been recognized by NPF.

Read more
[Essential oils]

## Essential Oils for Psoriasis

Curious about essential oils for psoriasis? Some oils contain compounds that may help reduce
inflammation, ease discomfort, or promote relaxation. Learn what they can (and can’t) do, and how to
use them safely.

Read more

## Psoriasis Simplified

Your journey with psoriatic disease is unique, but it doesn’t have to be confusing. Explore the NPF
Care Path and take the first step toward getting care and living your healthiest life.

elegance, and generosity at the New England Soirée! Together, let's raise critical funds to drive
progress toward curing psoriatic disease and improving the lives of those affected. Join us in
honoring Dr. Avery H. LaChance and Dr. Abrar Qureshi.

Learn More About This Event

## We are the International Hyperhidrosis Society.

The world's only non-profit organization serving all who sweat excessively.

[Learn About Us][4]

## 385 MILLION people suffer from excessive, uncontrollable sweating.

That's right. Nearly **5%** of the global population are like you, looking for help.

[Get Help][5]

## Studies. Research. Clinical Trials.

International Hyperhidrosis Society facilitates research to improve hyperhidrosis care and
understanding.

[Participate in Research][6]

## Podcasts

podcast for anyone living with a sweat disorder or concerned or curious about issues of human
perspiration -- including excessive sweating or hyperhidrosis (Hh.)

[Listen Up!][7]

## Watch our Video

While hyperhidrosis may not be a life threatening condition, it's deeply life-altering, with
overwhelming effects on social, professional, and home life.

[Watch the Video][8]

They would fill a Stadium.

[[Screenshot_2024-06-06_at_6.50.38_PM.png][Asset-7q2.png]Hyperhidrosis][188] is a serious medical
condition characterized by excessive, uncontrollable sweating and the International Hyperhidrosis
Society is the only global non-profit organization dedicated entirely to improving the lives of
those affected by it.

We are your source for reliable, up-to-date information about
hyperhidrosis [treatments][189] and [research][190]. We're also here to provide you with
understanding and support. If your life is being ruined by sweating - you are NOT alone. Studies
show that hyperhidrosis is common, severe, and emotionally damaging. 

[Research][191] shows that nearly 5% of the world's population suffers from [excessive
sweating][192] or [hyperhidrosis][193]. That's right, 385 MILLION people are struggling with extreme
sweating -- just like you!

Of course, no one's hyperhidrosis is exactly the same. Some people fill their [shoes][194] with
sweat, some have dripping [no-handshakes-please palms][195], some sweat through their [shirts][196],
others sweat through their [jeans][197], and most have a combination of sweaty body areas to contend
with. Regardless of whether you sweat dramatically on your [head][198] or your toes or anywhere in
between, we know the embarrassment, anxiety, and crippling effects are real and we want to help.

As the only independent, global, non-profit advocacy and education organization serving the
hyperhidrosis community, we encourage you to use this website to get smarter about [excessive
sweating][199]. Read, print, [participate][200], download, and [sign-up][201] today.

While you are doing that, we'll be running [medical education courses in hyperhidrosis][202] to help
healthcare providers provide the best hyperhidrosis care possible, supporting new hyperhidrosis
treatment research, talking to journalists around the world to encourage empathy and awareness,
providing you with useful news alerts, and applying for [grants][203] so we can keep going. 

Here are a few of the useful things you'll find on the following pages: comprehensive [treatment
option information][204], U.S. [insurance codes][205], [hyperhidrosis clinical
trials][206] recruiting now, a [Clinician Finder][207], an award-winning [free blog ][208] dedicated
to sweat news, and amazing [product discounts][209] on the most useful sweat-management products.
Your sweat is nearly always with you. We want to be there too.

Feeling the love? Share it! We are stronger when we work together. [Donate][210] today to help us
find a cure and increase public awareness. Yes, tomorrow CAN be better than today.

facilities, tribal healthcare programs, and urban Indian health organizations access the products
they need with responsive, relationship-first service.

Why Tribal Innovations

## Native ownership, workflow capability, and fulfillment depth — together

Tribal Innovations combines Native-owned positioning with the operational capability and supply
depth to actually deliver — making us a more credible partner for Indian health organizations.

### Native-owned and procurement-aligned

Built to serve Indian Health Service facilities, tribally operated healthcare programs, and urban
Indian health organizations through a Native-owned business model.

Tribal’s model is designed to help manage invoicing, account coordination, and the practical steps
required to move orders forward.

### Supply depth through a national partner

The company’s operating model combines community alignment with broader fulfillment infrastructure,

fulfill reliably. Tribal Innovations addresses this directly: as an authorized Cardinal Health

— through a Native-owned partner.

Reliable fulfillment through an established national supply network

Native-owned positioning without sacrificing product depth or reliability

What We Bring

Indian health procurement rewards vendors who show up reliably over time. Tribal Innovations is
built around the capabilities that make that possible.

Authorized Cardinal Health distributor — access to a broad national catalog, not a thin sourcing
list.

Native-owned positioning aligned with Indian health procurement pathways and preference programs.

Invoicing and billing support designed for Indian health settings, including coordination with
government payment workflows.

Direct, responsive account management — a real relationship, not a ticketing system.

A fulfillment model built for reliability, so the order that gets placed is the order that arrives.

Family Leadership

## Rooted in Jemez Pueblo, built for the long term

Tribal Innovations is led by a family with deep community roots in Jemez Pueblo and a clear
commitment to service, trust, and long-term follow-through.

# Services in Austin and Central Texas

At Tru-Skin Dermatology, we specialize in medical dermatology and various [skin conditions][108],
helping patients maintain healthy skin. We treat a wide range of conditions from [acne][109] to
psoriasis, but our primary focus has been on treating various types of [skin cancer][110].
Additionally, we offer cosmetic dermatology services, including [BOTOX® injections][111], fillers,
and photofacials. Our extensive range of aesthetic procedures includes microdermabrasion,
microneedling, chemical peels, rosacea treatment, laser hair removal, hair loss restoration, and
more. Our dedicated team of professionals is trained in the latest techniques, ensuring you receive
the most effective treatments.

for several reasons:

We are a physician-owned practice dedicated to keeping your skin healthy. Our primary focus is on
medical dermatology and maintaining skin health. While we offer a variety of cosmetic procedures,
each is designed to enhance your skin’s natural beauty and health. And, we are dedicated to
providing you with the most successful patient outcomes by offering non-surgical skin cancer
treatment with the SRT-100. We strive to prevent, detect, and treat skin cancer, ensuring your skin

# Welcome to Tru-Skin: Where We Provide Advanced Dermatology, Skin Cancer Care, and Cosmetic
# Services in Austin and Central Texas

At Tru-Skin Dermatology, we specialize in medical dermatology and various [skin conditions][108],
helping patients maintain healthy skin. We treat a wide range of conditions from [acne][109] to
psoriasis, but our primary focus has been on treating various types of [skin cancer][110].
Additionally, we offer cosmetic dermatology services, including [BOTOX® injections][111], fillers,
and photofacials. Our extensive range of aesthetic procedures includes microdermabrasion,
microneedling, chemical peels, rosacea treatment, laser hair removal, hair loss restoration, and
more. Our dedicated team of professionals is trained in the latest techniques, ensuring you receive
the most effective treatments. 

When searching for a dermatologist, you have many local options, but Tru-Skin Dermatology stands out
for several reasons:

We are a physician-owned practice dedicated to keeping your skin healthy. Our primary focus is on
medical dermatology and maintaining skin health. While we offer a variety of cosmetic procedures,
each is designed to enhance your skin’s natural beauty and health. And, we are dedicated to
providing you with the most successful patient outcomes by offering non-surgical skin cancer
treatment with the SRT-100. We strive to prevent, detect, and treat skin cancer, ensuring your skin
remains healthy and vibrant.

Choose Tru-Skin Dermatology for patient-focused dermatology care. We look forward to helping you
reach your healthy skin goals.

## Meet Our Founder: Daniel J. Ladd, DO

[Daniel J. Ladd, Jr., DO][114] is the Medical Director and Founder of Tru-Skin Dermatology in
Austin, Texas. He earned his BA from the University of Texas at Austin and received his medical
degree from Des Moines University in 1999. He completed his Dermatology residency at the Northeast
Regional Medical Center in Kirksville, Missouri in conjunction with the Dermatology Institute of
North Texas in 2004. 

He is a member in good standing of the American Academy of Dermatology, American Osteopathic College
of Dermatology, the American Society of Dermatologic Surgeons and the American Society of Cosmetic
Dermatology and Aesthetic Surgery, as well as a Member of the American Society of Mohs Surgery.
Daniel J. Ladd, DO is a lifetime member of the Skin Cancer Foundation’s Amonette Circle, an elite
group of the country’s foremost dermatologists and Mohs surgeons who have made a commitment to skin
cancer education and prevention

## We Always Put Our Patients First at Tru-Skin Dermatology

Since its inception in 2004, Tru-Skin Dermatology has grown significantly, now proudly serving
Central Texas with [seven convenient locations][115]. This expansion allows us to accommodate a
larger number of patients while reducing their travel time. Our offices are strategically located in
[Austin][116], [Bastrop][117], [Cedar Park][118], [Hallettsville][119], [Spring Branch][120], [La
Grange][121], and [Round Rock][122], making quality dermatological care more accessible. Our
dedicated doctors take the time to thoroughly address each patient’s needs, ensuring all questions
are answered and concerns are properly attended to. At Tru-Skin Dermatology, we prioritize patient
satisfaction and comprehensive care.

## Meet Our Founder: Daniel J. Ladd, DO

[Daniel J. Ladd, Jr., DO][114] is the Medical Director and Founder of Tru-Skin Dermatology in
Austin, Texas. He earned his BA from the University of Texas at Austin and received his medical
degree from Des Moines University in 1999. He completed his Dermatology residency at the Northeast
Regional Medical Center in Kirksville, Missouri in conjunction with the Dermatology Institute of
North Texas in 2004. 

He is a member in good standing of the American Academy of Dermatology, American Osteopathic College
of Dermatology, the American Society of Dermatologic Surgeons and the American Society of Cosmetic
Dermatology and Aesthetic Surgery, as well as a Member of the American Society of Mohs Surgery.
Daniel J. Ladd, DO is a lifetime member of the Skin Cancer Foundation’s Amonette Circle, an elite
group of the country’s foremost dermatologists and Mohs surgeons who have made a commitment to skin
cancer education and prevention

## We Always Put Our Patients First at Tru-Skin Dermatology

Since its inception in 2004, Tru-Skin Dermatology has grown significantly, now proudly serving
Central Texas with [seven convenient locations][115]. This expansion allows us to accommodate a
larger number of patients while reducing their travel time. Our offices are strategically located in
[Austin][116], [Bastrop][117], [Cedar Park][118], [Hallettsville][119], [Spring Branch][120], [La
Grange][121], and [Round Rock][122], making quality dermatological care more accessible. Our
dedicated doctors take the time to thoroughly address each patient’s needs, ensuring all questions
are answered and concerns are properly attended to. At Tru-Skin Dermatology, we prioritize patient
satisfaction and comprehensive care.

Tru-Skin Dermatology in Texas is renowned for its exceptional medical dermatology services. We excel
in providing top-tier treatment and preventive care for a comprehensive range of skin, hair, and
nail conditions. With a dedicated focus on dermatology, our highly skilled team is devoted to
helping you achieve your skincare goals through diverse cutting-edge services. We also intend to
look out for your general well-being. From personalized treatment plans to advanced procedures, we
prioritize your skin health and well-being with a holistic approach to dermatological care. Schedule
your initial consultation at [Tru-Skin today][123].
